title: Build writing editor component
story: As a user, I want a distraction-free text area to write in during my exercise so that I can focus on the prompt.
acceptance_criteria: A Editor component renders a textarea for free-text input
The editor is focused automatically when the exercise starts
The editor accepts a disabled prop — when true, input is locked (used when timer expires)
The current text value is lifted to parent state via an onChange callback
Unit tests cover rendering, input changes, and disabled state
